physical: Relativistic Doppler effect — Light from a source receding at speed v is received at a lower frequency by the factor square root of (1 − β) over (1 + β); approaching, higher. No medium is involved and only the relative velocity matters. Formula: f' = f × √((1 − β) ÷ (1 + β))
reflected_formula: (a rate with no partner) = (a rate with no partner) × √((1 − (rise per Expansion ÷ Current)) ÷ (1 + (rise per Expansion ÷ Current)))
reflected_sentence: In Vibrational Reality, what is sent at one strength is met at another as rise per Expansion shifts: moving apart weakens it, moving together strengthens it.
rule_reason: No cost caused by resistance and no separation made by distance is named; the shift is a kinematic relation of relative motion, not a cost, so it keeps its shape.
interpretation: The relation keeps its shape. Velocity reflects to rise per Expansion; c is Current. Physical frequency has no partner, so the reflection speaks only of strength weakening or strengthening with relative motion.
closing: The rule decided on its own: no resistance-cost, keeps shape. Recession and approach are relative motion, not distance-made separation, so the turn does not fire.
